test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the given options.

The earth has a exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival.

options.text: An earth has an exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival.
A earth has exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival.
An earth has exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival.
The earth has an exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect article "**a**" before the term "**exceptional structure**."
 
• The word "exceptional" begins with a vowel sound and should be preceded by the article "**an**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the earth has an exceptional structure**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the use of the article before "exceptional structure" in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The earth has an exceptional structure which may have helped in life’s arrival."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The:** "The earth has" is correct as it specifies a particular noun (earth).
 
• **An:** "an exceptional structure" uses the correct article for a noun starting with a vowel sound.
 
• **Structure:** "structure which may have helped" is grammatically correct.
 
• **Life’s arrival:** "in life’s arrival" is grammatically and contextually correct.
